final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS c FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.f AS f, s1.c AS c, s1.c * 1.0 / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL AND s2.t <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.f, s3.c, s3.r, s3.c * 1.0 / s4.a FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL AND s4.a <> 0
